descriptions.long: Red Hat OpenShift AI gives data scientists, ML engineers, and developers a powerful platform for building intelligent applications. It allows organizations to quickly build and deploy AI/ML models by integrating open source tools with commercial partner solutions in an easy-to-configure environment. OpenShift AI provides common open source tooling, such as Jupyter notebooks and associated TensorFlow and PyTorch frameworks in a supported product that runs on Red Hat OpenShift.
descriptions.short: Red Hat OpenShift AI gives data scientists and developers a powerful AI/ML platform for building intelligent applications. It provides a fully supported environment to develop, train, test, and deploy AI/ML models.

features.description: Conduct exploratory data science in JupyterLab with access to core AI / ML libraries and frameworks including TensorFlow and PyTorch using our notebook images or your own.
features.title: Model development

features.description: Deploy models across any cloud, fully managed, and self-managed OpenShift footprint.
features.title: Model serving

features.description: Optional partner offerings integrated into the dashboard to complement core platform capabilities and address key needs within the data science workflow.
features.title: Integrated offerings
